events.headline: IRDAI draft norms to cap insurance distribution commissions, curb loan-linked insurance sales
events.summary: IRDAI proposed draft rules capping the commissions insurers pay distributors (including bancassurance channels) and restricting the bundling/sale of insurance tied to loan disbursement. The move hit insurance stocks hard (PB Fintech -36%) and dragged bank/NBFC stocks down on fears of reduced bancassurance fee income. IIFL Securities has previously estimated a bancassurance commission cap could impact banks' net profit by 1-2%.
